adds.title: Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Jameson turns down Peter's ordinary photos and haggles over a Spider-Man shot. Later he fires and rehires Peter in one breath to cover his son's party.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's stingy boss, who haggles over every shot.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Jameson's photographer, fired and rehired in one breath.
adds.evidence: Bugle office: Jameson rejects Peter's dog/pigeon photos, calls the Spider-Man shot 'stinks', pays $300; later 'You're fired... Oh, right. You're un-fired, I need you' for the planetarium party for his son.

adds.title: Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Robbie presses Jameson for a front page and insists Spider-Man is not a menace. When Mary Jane goes missing, he brings Jameson the news.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An editor who argues Spider-Man is no menace.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Robbie's boss, who runs Spider-Man as a menace.
adds.evidence: Robbie: 'We got 6 minutes to deadline, Jonah!', 'I told you he's not a menace!'; later 'Still no word on the whereabouts of your son's fiancee. Sorry, Jonah.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Betty relays a call from Jameson's wife about his lost checkbook, and Jameson has her pay the garbage man who brings in Spider-Man's suit.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A secretary who relays his calls and pays out his deals.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Sends Betty running with his orders.
adds.evidence: Betty on intercom: 'your wife's on the line! She said she lost your checkbook!'; Jameson: 'Miss Brant, give this man his money and throw in a bar of soap!' to the garbage man with the suit.

adds.title: Spider-Man 2
adds.text: Hoffman suggests the name Doctor Octopus, and Jameson brushes it off, then claims it as his own.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A staffer whose villain name Jameson takes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Ted's Doctor Octopus idea as his own.
adds.evidence: Jameson: 'Hoffman!' Hoffman: 'Doctor Octopus!' ... Jameson: 'But it's taken! Wait, wait! I got it! Doctor Octopus.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Jameson pits Peter against Eddie Brock for a staff job. After Peter exposes Eddie's faked photo, Jameson fires Eddie and makes Peter staff photographer.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's boss, who gives him the staff job.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'Peter exposes the misconduct of his rival photographer Eddie Brock... Jameson fires Brock and promotes Peter to staff photographer.' Wikiquote: 'You want a staff job, you want a staff job... Whoever brings me that photo gets a job.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Ursula scolds Peter for snapping at her father over the rent. When he apologizes, she tells him he is a good boy.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The landlord's daughter, who forgives him for snapping.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A tenant Ursula forgives for snapping at her father.
adds.evidence: After Peter yells at Mr. Ditkovich, Ursula: 'That wasn't cool.' Later Peter: 'Ursula, hey, listen, about earlier...' Ursula: 'Don't worry about it, you're a good boy.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Robbie confirms to Jameson that Eddie Brock's photo is a fake and warns that the Bugle must print a retraction.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An editor who proves Eddie's photo is fake.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Robbie's boss, forced into a retraction.
adds.evidence: Robbie to Jameson: 'It's a fake. Empire State Photographic Department confirms it.' ... 'You know we're gonna have to print a retraction now.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Betty reminds Jameson to watch his blood pressure, and he snaps at her for swooning over Peter.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A secretary who reminds him to watch his blood pressure.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Snaps at Betty for swooning over Peter.
adds.evidence: Brant on intercom: 'Your blood pressure, Mr. Jameson. Your wife told me to tell you to watch the anger.' Later Jameson: 'Miss Brant, that's not the position I hired you for.'

adds.title: Spider-Man 3
adds.text: Jameson loses patience with Hoffman's new slogan pitch, and when Hoffman pipes up again, tells him to shut up and get out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A staffer whose pitches Jameson shouts down.
adds.evidence: Jameson '[grows impatient with Hoffman proposing a new slogan]' 'Get on with it, you moron!'; Hoffman: 'I do.' Jameson: 'Shut up. Get out.'

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man 2
owner_calls.question: Do May and Mary Jane share Peter's birthday party early in Spider-Man 2 (where Mary Jane tells Peter about John)? Sources confirm the party and that May has seen Mary Jane's play, but none I could reach places May and Mary Jane in a scene together.
options: Add friend stage: 'Mary Jane comes to Peter's birthday party at May's house, and May goes to see her play.'
None: no direct exchange on screen
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database MJ page: John 'whom she told him about at his birthday party'; 'The Importance of Being Earnest, which John, Harry, and Aunt May had seen'.

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man 2
owner_calls.question: Bernard is credited in Spider-Man 2 but no source I could reach describes a scene between him and Harry. If he is seen serving Harry at the Osborn home, add a stage; otherwise none.
options: Add boss stage: 'Bernard still serves Harry at the Osborn home.'
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia cast: 'John Paxton... reprise[s] [his role] as... Osborn family butler Bernard Houseman' in Spider-Man 2; Marvel Database and Wikiquote record no Bernard scene there.

owner_calls.title: Spider-Man 3
owner_calls.question: In Spider-Man 3 May gives Peter her engagement ring to propose to Mary Jane and tells him to put his wife first, and both attend Harry's funeral, but I found no direct exchange between May and Mary Jane. Does May acting on Mary Jane's behalf count as dealing with her?
options: Add friend stage: 'May gives Peter her own engagement ring so he can propose to Mary Jane.'
None: only talked about, never an exchange
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database May page: 'She then took off her engagement ring and asked Peter to use it to propose to MJ'; 'After Harry's death, May attended his funeral.'
